concerns.text: Constitution Principle III requires every file under data/ to be checksummed and recorded in state/projects/PROJ-116-.../artifact_hashes.yaml. No task computes checksums of the raw OQMD CSV or processed parquet files, nor updates artifact_hashes.yaml. T011 only saves the raw CSV. This silently drops a constitutional constraint the plan's Constitution Check marks as PASS.

T032 only benchmarks runtime/memory ('Ensure total runtime ≤ 4 h and peak RAM ≤ 7 GB') but the spec Assumptions state 'if exceeded, the system must log an error and terminate gracefully.' No task implements enforcement/abort-on-exceedance; the constraint is reduced to passive measurement, weakening FR-006.

plan.md's Complexity Tracking sanctions a Permutation Test ('Required to handle non-normal error distributions') and VIF Analysis ('Required to quantify collinearity'), and the plan's evaluate.py description includes 'Permutation Tests'. No task in tasks.md implements either analysis — dropped plan constraints.

T006 sets up 'random-seed handling' in config.py, but no downstream task (T013, T020, T028) states that seeds are actually pinned/used in training and splitting. Constitution Principle I (NON-NEGOTIABLE) requires seeds pinned in code/; make the seed usage explicit in the training tasks to avoid silent drift.
